tables.definition: Compounded one-session price returns aligned to target_dates in the price-only diagnostic.

limitations: Reduced price-only diagnostic, not original full HGA-MT data.

tables.definition: Compounded CRSP CIZ total daily returns on the native realization-date axis.
tables.source_review: usdata.py retains raw dlyret directly in total_return; labels separately shift dlyretx by two sessions and are not used here.
limitations: Tradeability is not used to erase a valid delisting return.
No missing daily return is replaced by zero or cash after delisting.
eligible_at_formation records prior month-end membership; full source axis retained.

tables.definition: Compounded adjusted-close daily price returns.
tables.source_review: scripts/build_data.py: CSI totalret[:,1:] is close[:,1:]/close[:,:-1]-1; SP500 totalret copies the raw CRSP dlyret channel. Both are same-day realized returns, unlike the overlapping ranking label.
limitations: Despite the filename totalret.npy, the CSI panel is an adjusted-price ratio; dividend-total-return equivalence is not independently asserted.

tables.definition: Compounded CRSP CIZ daily total simple returns.
tables.source_review: scripts/build_data.py: CSI totalret[:,1:] is close[:,1:]/close[:,:-1]-1; SP500 totalret copies the raw CRSP dlyret channel. Both are same-day realized returns, unlike the overlapping ranking label.
limitations: Tradeability is not used to erase valid delisting returns; missing source days make the monthly return null.

tables.definition: Exact adjacent month-end native Qlib close ratio for securities whose CSI300 membership overlaps the declared 2010–2022 sample.
tables.source_review: run.py and implementation.py read native Qlib $close; this exporter reads the same shared close.day.bin fields and calendar offsets directly, then uses exact month-end ratios rather than overlapping 20-session targets.
limitations: Input-universe price returns, not AlphaQCM strategy or monthly forecast performance.
No daily model score is relabeled as a monthly prediction.
Vendor adjustment convention is inherited; dividend-total-return equivalence is not independently asserted.
eligible_at_formation marks prior month-end CSI membership; all selected security rows are retained.

tables.definition: Actual calendar-month total simple return preserved in the monthly equity adaptation position ledger, including unheld eligible securities.
tables.source_review: portfolio.py backtest copies z[total_return] unchanged to source_return; used_return is separately zero-filled and is deliberately not exported. analyze.py verifies source_return against the original panel and averages seed scores by yyyymm/permno.

scores.meaning: Prespecified mean monthly Archetype full policy score across saved seeds; not a calibrated return forecast

limitations: Original financial-graph input cache is unavailable; realized returns are taken from the retained source_return field, not independently reloaded from that missing cache.
Monthly US equity adaptation, not original high-frequency crypto experiment.

tables.firm_identifier: CRSP PERMNO security identifier; distinct from company PERMCO
tables.definition: Actual CRSP holding-calendar-month total simple return in the equity extension, paired with same-month outperformance probability.
tables.source_review: equity/build_panel.py exact-joins r.ym=u.ym+1, r.ret=CRSP mthret; date is that holding month end. No shift across missing months. run_equity.py fits a logistic model and saves p for the holding-month target.

scores.meaning: Probability the security holding-month total return exceeds broad market total return; not expected return

limitations: Equity extension, not the original binary-event-contract theorem.
Missing target returns remain null; portfolio missing-return substitutions are not used.

tables.definition: Calendar-month compound of actual single-session CRSP total simple returns present in the prepared eligible security panel. Incomplete security-months remain unavailable.
tables.source_review: scripts/prepare.py assigns ret_1=d.ret, directly from dated CRSP dlyret. It is a contemporaneous one-day input. yret_1/yret_5/yret_21 are forward labels and never used here. Eligibility is prior-month; source history_ok filters may remove dates, which this exporter treats as missing.
limitations: Only firm-month keys appearing in the prepared panel are included; universe/history filters are inherited.
Every source calendar session must have a finite security return; delisted/incompletely observed months remain null rather than silently treated as cash.
First and last panel months excluded conservatively. No multi-session model prediction is relabeled as monthly.

references.definition: RADAR CZ adaptation reads the exact PRISM-VQ SP500 dates.npy, symbols.npy and totalret.npy arrays; reuse that existing month-return table.
references.evidence: prism-vq/experiments/cz_vw/build.py shares base arrays; archived data/{dates,symbols,totalret}.npy symlinks target prism-vq-reproduction/data/sp500. RADAR protocol-pr/experiments/cz_vw/data.py consumes --shared_data.
limitations: Reference covers the shared input return universe, not only RADAR prediction rows or its altered member screen.
Daily RADAR prediction scores are not monthly forecasts.
